SectionCut__Engine__Description: Configuration for the section cut engine - the boolean cut-and-fill layer ported from the ValeVision3D cross section tool. This module owns clipping planes, cap fill meshes and profile outlines only. It knows nothing about floor plans; the Floor Plan Views system drives it with horizontal planes. All distance values are integer millimetres and are converted to Three.js units in code.

SectionCut__Appearance__Config.SectionCut__Appearance__Description: Cut fill and profile line appearance. The fill is the solid poche you see where a wall is sliced; the line is the outline drawn around each cut island.

SectionCut__Update__Config.SectionCut__Update__Description: Live update tuning. DragRecomputeMs throttles the cap rebuild while a datum slider is being dragged; the remaining values are geometry weld and filter tolerances passed straight to the cap geometry engine.
